summary: ING Groep filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Andrea Cesaroni as chief risk officer, effective June 8, 2026, replacing Ljiljana ortan who stepped down to head Wholesale Banking. Cesaroni, previously head of Integrated Risk and ad interim head of Risk since February 2026, will be proposed for the Executive Board at an EGM on July 31, 2026. The ECB has approved the appointment. This is a planned, orderly management succession, not a forced departure. The press release notes no unusual terms or material conflict—just a routine C-suite transition. Watch for shareholder approval at the EGM; no risk-arb angle.
